verses.text: Great is Jehovah, and greatly to be praised, In the city of our God, in his holy mountain.

segments.text: Great is Jehovah, and greatly to be praised,
In the city of our God, in his holy mountain.

verses.text: Beautiful in elevation, the joy of the whole earth, Is mount Zion, on the sides of the north, The city of the great King.

segments.text: Beautiful in elevation, the joy of the whole earth,
Is mount Zion,
on
the sides of the north,
The city of the great King.

verses.text: God hath made himself known in her palaces for a refuge.

segments.text: God hath made himself known in her palaces for a refuge.

verses.text: For, lo, the kings assembled themselves, They passed by together.

segments.text: For, lo, the kings assembled themselves,
They passed by together.

verses.text: They saw it, then were they amazed; They were dismayed, they hasted away.

segments.text: They saw it, then were they amazed;
They were dismayed, they hasted away.

verses.text: Trembling took hold of them there, Pain, as of a woman in travail.

segments.text: Trembling took hold of them there,
Pain, as of a woman in travail.

verses.text: With the east wind Thou breakest the ships of Tarshish.

segments.text: With the east wind
Thou breakest the ships of Tarshish.

verses.text: As we have heard, so have we seen In the city of Jehovah of hosts, in the city of our God: God will establish it for ever. [Selah

segments.text: As we have heard, so have we seen
In the city of Jehovah of hosts, in the city of our God:
God will establish it for ever. [Selah

verses.text: We have thought on thy lovingkindness, O God, In the midst of thy temple.

segments.text: We have thought on thy lovingkindness, O God,
In the midst of thy temple.

verses.text: As is thy name, O God, So is thy praise unto the ends of the earth: Thy right hand is full of righteousness.

segments.text: As is thy name, O God,
So is thy praise unto the ends of the earth:
Thy right hand is full of righteousness.

verses.text: Let mount Zion be glad, Let the daughters of Judah rejoice, Because of thy judgments.

segments.text: Let mount Zion be glad,
Let the daughters of Judah rejoice,
Because of thy judgments.

verses.text: Walk about Zion, and go round about her; Number the towers thereof;

segments.text: Walk about Zion, and go round about her;
Number the towers thereof;

verses.text: Mark ye well her bulwarks; Consider her palaces: That ye may tell it to the generation following.

segments.text: Mark ye well her bulwarks;
Consider her palaces:
That ye may tell it to the generation following.

verses.text: For this God is our God for ever and ever: He will be our guide even unto death.

segments.text: For this God is our God for ever and ever:
He will be our guide
even
unto death.

headings.text: A Song; a Psalm of the sons of Korah.
